A [[Steel Ingot]] is a rare crafting material which can be used to [[craft]] some types of [[armor]].  

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
* Select [[artisan]]s will craft one Steel Ingot for 1 [[Lump of Charcoal]], 10 [[Iron Ingot]]s and 200 {{gold}}.
* Random drop from [[Hidden Treasure]] in [[dungeons]].
* [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Steel Ingots.
** See [[:Category:Contains steel]] for other items.
* No [[creature]]s currently appear to [[drop]] [[:Category:Drops steel|Steel Ingots]].
